추적 안 함 모드에서 훅이 첫 프롬프트에 moai 안내를 싣는다

text: moai-zynt 의 추적 안 함 모드는 AGENTS.md 를 안 건드리고 Claude Code 훅으로만 안내를 싣는다. 다른 에이전트에 심을 때 이 모드에서 그쪽이 moai 를 어떻게 알게 할지를 같이 정할 것

설계 — 선택 상자의 상태를 이렇게 다룬다(2026-10-06)

- **저장하는 상태는 사람이 고른 값뿐이다.** 칸마다 `Option<값>` — `None` 은 "기본값을 따른다". 기본값·보이는가·잠겼는가는 그릴 때마다 고른 값에서 다시 셈한다. 파생값을 저장하지 않는다는 저장소 규약과 같은 결
- **한 길로 모은다**: `Choices`(칸마다 Option) → `resolve(&Choices, Defaults) -> Result<Plan, Conflict>` → `init::run(&Plan)`. 플래그도 화면도 `Choices` 를 만들 뿐이라 같은 `resolve` 를 지난다 — 화면과 플래그가 다른 결과를 낼 길이 구조로 없다
- **`Plan` 은 빈칸이 없는 값이다**: prefix, tracking(Tracked | Local(Exclude | Gitignore)), guide(Block | File | Hook), driver, skill, project. `run` 은 `Plan` 만 받고 판단하지 않는다
- **규칙은 `resolve` 한 곳에 표로 둔다**:
  - guide 기본 = tracking 이 Tracked 면 File, 아니면 Hook
  - driver 는 Tracked 일 때만 선다. Local 이면 칸이 숨고 값은 false
  - guide = Hook 이면 skill = true 로 잠긴다
- **기본값 묶음은 둘이다** — `Defaults::Screen`(Local·Exclude, Hook, skill·project 켬)과 `Defaults::Plain`(지금 그대로: Tracked, Block, driver 켬, skill·project 끔). 터미널이 아닌 init 은 Plain 이다. 두 묶음을 한 const 표에 나란히 둔다
- **모순은 두 표면에서 다르게 선다**: 화면은 잠가서 못 고르게 하고, 플래그로 준 모순(`--guide hook --no-skill`)은 `resolve` 가 `Conflict` 를 내서 BAD_INPUT 으로 거절한다 — 조용히 한쪽을 이기게 하지 않는다
- **화면 조각은 순수하다**(`tui/picker.rs` 꼴): 키 → 다음 `Choices`. 그릴 때는 `resolve` 의 보조 함수(`view_of(&Choices, Defaults)`)로 칸마다 보임·잠김·실제 값을 얻는다
- **시험**: 선택 공간이 작다(3×3×2×2×2 + None). 전부 훑어 불변식을 박는다 — Hook ⇒ skill, Local ⇒ !driver·!gitattributes, `resolve` 는 모든 조합에서 끝난다. 플래그로 만든 `Choices` 와 키로 만든 `Choices` 가 같은 `Plan` 을 내는지도 본다

설계 덧붙임 — 규칙은 한 방향으로만 흐른다(2026-10-06 사용자 결정)

- 칸 사이 규칙의 순서를 고정한다: 추적 → 안내 → 설치 → 드라이버. 앞 칸은 뒤 칸의 기본값·보임·잠김을 정할 수 있고, 뒤 칸은 앞 칸을 못 건드린다
- 그래서 `resolve` 는 이 순서로 한 번 훑으면 답이 난다 — 다시 돌거나 수렴을 기다리지 않는다
- 이 순서를 거스르는 규칙이 필요해지면 그때가 설계를 다시 볼 때다. 그 문제는 상태 머신이 아니라 제약 풀이다
- 사람이 고른 값(`Some`)이 앞 칸 때문에 무효가 되면 지우지 않는다. 화면에서는 잠그고 실제 값은 `resolve` 가 정한다. 앞 칸을 되돌리면 고른 값이 그대로 돌아온다

**What I fixed** (all in `/home/go/Workspace/moai/.claude/worktrees/moai-zynt`):
- **The 15 above:**
  - **Detecting the tracking mode:** `git check-ignore` now probes `.moai/` and ignores `!` patterns. In-tree `*/.gitignore` sources count as the gitignore mode.
  - **Subdirectories and linked worktrees:** exclude lines get the subdirectory prefix, and keeping the tracker out of git is refused on a first plant in a linked worktree.
  - **One dotfile table:** `run`, `status` and `--check` now build the same file list. `status` asks git once under one 2s limit.
  - **Guide file:** the link block now carries a hash of the guide, and guide.md is read the same way as AGENTS.md (CRLF tolerated, FIFO skipped, errors name the right file).
  - **Ordering, exit code and terminal:** the ignore lines are written before `.moai/` is created. The partial-failure flag from the skill install is cleared so init exits 0, and raw mode is restored if the screen can't open.
  - **Screen input:** invalid flag values are refused before the screen opens, and an empty prefix is refused.
  - **Hints:** they use `-C` when needed, and the wording and docs now describe `--yes` correctly.
  - **CI gates:** `cargo fmt` and the clippy fix are applied.
- **Beyond the cap:**
  - **Link detection:** link mode is now recognised by a marker line, not by the path appearing in the block (a hand-written note mentioning `.moai/guide.md` used to switch a block-mode repo to link mode).
  - **Screen layout:** locked rows show only their value plus the "set by a flag" note, and the problem text wraps over two lines at 80 columns.
  - **Screen state:** a problem message clears when any row changes, and `--no-skill` no longer defaults the guide to hooks.
  - **New flag:** I added `--driver`, the missing pair to `--no-driver`. It's a new CLI flag: dropping it would only mean adjusting the help text.
  - **Warnings and output:** gitignore-mode trackers get their own warning (`gitignore_local_rules`), and `--check --json` gains a `tracking` key for out-of-git trackers.
  - **Smaller cleanups:** messages are stripped of control characters before printing, and a doc comment in `guide.rs` is back on the right function.
  - **Docs:** CHANGELOG, workflow/agents pages (including their `Decided in:` lines) and README updated; `docs/cli.md` regenerated.
- **Tests:** 17 regression tests added (unit and CLI). fmt and clippy are clean, the 694 CLI tests pass, and 1868 of 1869 unit tests pass. The one failure is `skill::tests::a_binary_that_cannot_run_says_so_without_blocking`, which is machine-specific and also fails on develop (idea moai-78pr). Non-terminal `init` writes byte-identical files to HEAD.

**Skipped; the first two need a decision:**
- **Sibling worktrees:** a tracker kept out of git can't be found from a sibling linked worktree (`git worktree add ../x`), because the tracker lookup only climbs parent directories. The screen now defaults to exactly this mode. Fixing it means changing `store.rs`/`worktree.rs`, or reconsidering the default.
- **First init vs existing ignore rules:** a first `init` ignores an existing rule that already keeps `.moai/` out of git, so the second run switches mode. Fixing it would change the non-terminal output that was decided must stay identical.
- **Re-run writes a block:** a committed tracker planted with `--guide hook` or `none` gets the full AGENTS.md block on a later plain `init`. This matches the existing `--no-agents` behaviour and is now documented.
- **Minor edge cases:** a symlinked `.git/info/exclude` or `.moai`; ratatui's leftover panic hook; the hook reading AGENTS.md twice on the first prompt.
- **Cleanups and JSON naming:** typed enums for `--guide`/`--tracking`, reusing the TUI input and key-table components, merging `Flags` into `Choices`; the `"gitignore"` and `"driver":"skipped"` JSON keys for out-of-git trackers.
- **Unfixable:** commit 5292b882's subject has no id, and it's already merged.

I found 8 issues in the sibling-worktree tracker lookup. I fixed 3 and skipped 5. The fixes are in the working tree of `/home/go/Workspace/moai/.claude/worktrees/moai-n22o` and are not committed: per the repo convention they go in a separate `fix:` commit.

- **Findings 1 and 2.** `look` now returns `(root, Option<the same place in this worktree>)`. `Repo::find_from` stores that place as `moved_from`, the same way the committed-tracker redirect already does. ## 시험 자리에서 본 것 (clone 으로, 다 지웠다)

- 오늘의 develop 에 skeleton → `src/lib.rs 가 <sha> 에 없다` 로 거절

- 몸 한 글자·주석 한 글자·`Cargo.lock` 한 줄·기존 `tests/cli.rs` 고침·더러운 작업 트리·`Cargo.toml` 줄 지움·`[lib]` 밑의 다른 키·`src/main.rs` 덧줄 → 각각 그 줄을 짚고 거절
- surface: `mod store;` → `pub mod store;` + `pub(crate)` → `pub` 하나 → 통과. 맨 `fn` → `pub fn`, `src/id.rs` 고침, 몸 한 글자, `pub(super)` 고침, `mod tests` 열기, 주석 고침, 새 `tests/other.rs`, `Cargo.toml` 고침 → 거절. 새 `tests/lib_api.rs` + `CONTRIBUTING.md` 고침 → 통과

## 결정 (서브에이전트가 정하고 감독이 받았다)

- rustfmt 정규화는 줄 수가 달라졌을 때만 탄다. 줄 수가 같은데 어긋나면 원본 줄로 말한다 — 첫 판은 모든 실패에 정규화를 태워 `let  x`(겹 공백) 같은 몸 변경을 통과시켰다
- 정규화로 통과한 파일은 저장소 폭(rustfmt.toml)에서 rustfmt 의 고정점이어야 한다 — 겹 공백 같은 모양 차이를 숨겨 들이지 못하게
- `pub(crate) ` 가 주석이나 문자열 안에 있으면 거절한다(어림이고, 틀리면 거절 쪽이다)
- 얼린 파일(`src/id.rs`·`src/scratch.rs`·`src/git_leaks.rs`·`Cargo.lock`·`build.rs`, surface 는 `Cargo.toml` 까지)은 파일 단위로 거절한다
- clippy 경고는 서로 다른 `파일:줄:열: warning` 줄로 센다 — 타깃마다 같은 경고가 되풀이되기 때문이다. 기준선 파일도 같은 셈으로 적어야 한다
- `git clone --local` 은 이 기계에서 "Invalid cross-device link" 로 진다(scratch 가 다른 파일 시스템). `--shared` 나 `--no-hardlinks` 를 쓴다
- `pub(crate)` → `pub` 를 고치고 rustfmt 를 안 돌리면 줄 수가 같아 이 스크립트는 통과시킨다 — 그것은 CI 의 `cargo fmt --check` 가 잡는다

text: 사람 결정(2026-11-03): status --json 의 약 1% 지연(+0.22~0.36ms)은 받아들인다. G7 은 통과로 읽는다. 리뷰가 끝나면 develop 에 머지한다

## 리뷰 원문 — `/code-review max --fix /home/go/Workspace/moai/.worktrees/moai-72qj` (머리 `f841d469`)

Model ran: anthropic/opus-5.5

The review found 15 real problems: 14 in the three gate scripts and 1 in the product code. I fixed the 14 script problems and left the product item to you, because the epic's allow-list freezes those files. The product move is clean (`main` → `lib` + `run`): the improved gates show no difference between the old and new binaries. My fixes are in the worktree and are not committed. The recorded G3 and G4 results are now stale, so you must run the gates again (next steps below).

Line numbers refer to the reviewed head `f841d469`, before my fixes.

1. `scripts/bindiff_fuzz.py:679` — Cases that run moai where there is no `.moai` (`-C {home}`, `-C {tmp}`, hook `cwd`) make moai look upward for a tracker. If `--work` is under a moai project or a worktree, the writes go to that real tracker. Failure: `--work .worktrees/x/work`: the case `epic add … --dir {tmp}` finds the worktree's `.moai`, which redirects to the root tracker, and real rows are added. A finder reproduced it: the outer tracker went from 1 to 5 rows. The snapshot never sees these writes, and the old and new runs get different input.
2. `scripts/bindiff.py:841` — `HELD` is one global list, and every worker calls `reap()` after each run. With `--jobs` > 1 (the default), one worker kills the lock holder of another worker's 'mv lock held' case. Failure: Alone, `mv` exits 1 after 5 s ('backs off'). When another worker reaps, `mv` exits 0 in 0.6 s. So the lock-busy path was never tested, and old against old reported false differences at `--jobs 2`.
3. `scripts/bindiff.py:308` — The sandbox `MOAI_CTL_DIR` is made with mode 0755, but moai refuses any ctl dir that is not 0700. Every `ctl` case and web's ctl registration only test that refusal. Failure: 'ctl ls', 'ctl state', 'ctl sort' and every fuzzed `ctl` case exit 1 with 'must be … mode 0700' on both sides. The listing, 'No open window' and verb dispatch paths were never compared.
4. `scripts/bindiff.py:555` — `compare_lines` is applied to every file. Lines that hold a new id are compared as an unordered set, so the order of journal lines and the place of a new row in the snapshot are never checked. Failure: A journal with its create lines reversed, or a new row added at the end of `issues.jsonl` (which breaks sort order) → `compare()` returned []. Reproduced with real outcomes.
5. `scripts/bindiff.py:430` — `Masker` hides a whole hierarchical id, so the known parent part is lost. It also hides ids that the case itself passed in and the fixture ids (merge rows, `moai-brok`). Failure: A child minted as `<m3>.x` instead of `<m1>.x` → both become `<new-1>` → no difference. 'no row moai-aaaa.xyz' against 'no row moai-q7q7' → no difference.
6. `scripts/bindiff.py:936` — The merge-driver fixture rows use `created`/`updated`, but moai requires `created_at`, `updated_at` and `status_since`. No fixture row reads as an issue, so the per-issue 3-way merge never runs. Failure: The 'tags' fixture gives exit 1 with conflict markers. The same rows with the real field names merge to `tags:["a","b"]` with exit 0. The fuzzer copies the same wrong rows.
7. `scripts/bindiff_fuzz.py:251` — `kind_of` maps `--from` to a column name before the plan rule can match. Also, merge-driver arguments never get the `{tmp}/O`, `A`, `B` files the fuzzer lays out. Failure: In 3,000 cases, plan input on stdin came 1 time, `plan.md` 0 times and a full merge trio 0 times. After the fix: 24, 12 and 20.
8. `scripts/bindiff.py:338` — `snapshot()` records only bytes, not file modes. A nested git repo also survives `git clean -qfdx`. Failure: A refactor that drops the 0700 on the picks, beats or read-marks dirs would pass with no difference. Shown on hand-built snapshots.
9. `scripts/bindiff.py:1041` — `web_round` drops the server's stderr, its exit status and any stdout after the first line. The 'no url' path compares nothing, and requests follow `http_proxy` from the environment. Failure: The server's stderr already said 'ctl unavailable …' and nobody saw it. With a fake proxy set, the web comparison used the proxy's answers.
10. `scripts/bindiff.py:764` — Several hand-picked write cases only reach an error or a no-op. 'image add' reads a file that does not exist, 'link clear' uses `--clear`, which is not a flag, 'wiki learn' only shows `--help`, 'archive' and 'archive --drop' do nothing at the fixed clock, and 'project ls after add' starts from a fresh sandbox. Failure: In each pair, both binaries give the same error or 'archived 0 rows'. The image write, unblock, lesson write, archive move and drop paths were never compared.
11. `scripts/bindiff.py:866` — The setup leaves the test user holding m1 and m2, so the hook cases without held work never reach rule 2 ('pick something up first'). Failure: The Edit and `sed -i` hook events print nothing. The same events from a user who holds nothing get 'deny Rule 2'.
12. `scripts/check-refactor.py:283` — `_in_code` looks at one line only. In surface mode it accepts `pub(crate)` → `pub` inside multi-line strings, raw strings, after escaped quotes, and in block comments. Failure: A base with `"\npub(crate) fn shown() {}\n"` was changed by sed → 'surface 통과', exit 0, although a string value changed. Reproduced.
13. `scripts/check-refactor.py:227` — The Cargo.toml check skips content lines that start with `---`/`+++`, accepts `#` and blank lines inside multi-line TOML strings, and runs `git diff` with the user's color and hunk settings. Failure: A line added inside a multi-line `description` passed skeleton mode. With `color.ui=always` set, the correct branch was refused.
14. `scripts/bindiff_fuzz.py:904` — The fuzz worker catches only `Exception`, but `bindiff.git()` raises `SystemExit`. `bindiff.run_cases` has no handler, so a broken harness exits 1, the same code as 'differences found'. Failure: One failed `git reset` stops that worker. The run ends with only the git message (fuzzer, exit 2) or a traceback (bindiff, exit 1), and the differences found so far are not printed.
15. `src/tui/draw.rs:13438` — The bench instructions `cargo test --bin moai gantt_frame_costs` / `a_frame_costs` now run 0 tests, because the module tests moved to the lib target. Failure: `cargo test --bin moai -- --list` prints '0 tests'. The two bench tests are now listed only under `cargo test --lib`.

**Fixed** (only `scripts/bindiff.py`, `scripts/bindiff_fuzz.py`, `scripts/check-refactor.py`):
- Safety: the scripts refuse a `--work` directory that has a `.moai` in it or above it.
- Lock holders: each sandbox keeps its own lock holders and kills them at the end of its own run. The global `HELD` list is gone.
- ctl dir: it is now set to 0700. The script warns when the ctl socket path would be too long.
- Comparison: journal lines are compared in order; for sorted files, the comparison checks that both sides are sorted the same way; masking now keeps the known parent part of a new id; ids passed in by a case and the fixture ids are no longer hidden; file modes are compared; `git clean` now uses `-ffdx`, so nested repos are removed.
- web round: it now compares stderr, exit status, the rest of stdout and the 'no url' path. Only the port and the server's pid are masked, and requests ignore proxy settings.
- Cases: new `merge_row()` builds fixture rows with the real field names, for both scripts; the vacuous cases now reach their write paths; new hook cases from a user who holds nothing reach rule 2.
- Fuzzer generator: `--from` now gets a plan, and merge-driver gets its `O`/`A`/`B` files; searches, wiki slugs, `--var`, `--with <skill>` and `tui --path` now get fitting values; flags with optional values such as `--wiki [<slug>]` are parsed.
- check-refactor: a lexer that carries string and comment state across lines replaces `_in_code`; the Cargo.toml diff is parsed strictly, and the file is also compared as parsed TOML (`tomllib`); git runs with `-c color.ui=never`.
- Exit codes: harness errors now exit 2 and still print the report, and a run that compares nothing exits 2.
- Smaller: the fuzzer's repro line includes `--commit`; `resolve_case` uses `dataclasses.replace`, so it keeps `cwd`; the diff fallback message shows the first byte that differs; report lines are shell-quoted.
- Speed: mtimes are pinned only when they changed, sandboxes are built in parallel, identical outcomes skip the full compare, and the id regex is faster with the same matches (checked on all repo text and 50,000 random strings).
- Cleanup: dead wrappers are removed and the docstrings now list every mask.

**Skipped:**
- Outside the epic's allow-list, so these need you: the `draw.rs` bench commands, and the comments that are now wrong in `build.rs:49-50`, `src/scratch.rs:22-23`, `src/skill.rs` and `src/lib.rs` (`fn main`), plus the `[crate::main]` links in `init.rs` and `hook.rs`. I suggest an epic member or a follow-up issue, not a backlog item, because this epic broke the bench instruction.
- Design changes, left as follow-ups: a sandbox with a linked worktree, so worktree paths get tested; a pty lane, so terminal-only output gets tested; a narrower pick-nonce mask; a flaky rerun that names which side varies; a process pool, for speed; one shared help parser and shared setup helpers; removing the `HOOK_BIN`/`ROWS`/`IDS_NOW` globals.
- Not fixable: git does not show empty directories in the repo. The docstring now says so.

**Validation** (patched scripts):

| Run | Comparisons | Differences |
|---|---|---|
| bindiff old vs old | 1,034 | 0 |
| bindiff old vs new | 1,034 | 0 |
| bindiff old vs mutant | 1,034 | 6 (all planted) |
| fuzz old vs old | 3,000 | 0, no flakes |
| fuzz old vs new | 3,000 | 0 |
| fuzz old vs mutant | 1,200 | 11 (all planted) |

On a scratch commit, `check-refactor` passes skeleton mode on this branch and still accepts the natural rustfmt-fold case in surface mode. The new lexer reads all 197 real `pub(crate)` uses in `src/` as code.

**Next steps:** 1. Commit the fix as `fix(scripts): … (moai-72qj.7fu)`. G5 refuses until then because the tree is dirty. 2. Run G5. 3. Run G3 (now 1,034 comparisons, not 994). 4. Run G4 in full, 10,000 cases × en·ko, and write the new seed in the note — the generator changed, so seed 1793676997 no longer gives the recorded cases. 5. Update the j6p note: the masks are now new-id segments, the pick nonce, and the web port and pid; modes are compared and journals are compared in order. 6. Two new requirements: `check-refactor.py` skeleton mode needs Python 3.11 or later (`tomllib`); a `--work` under `$HOME` is refused if `~/.moai` exists; the default temp dir is fine.

One conventions point needs no action: the test-path line change in `lib.rs` happened without a recorded stop, but the review brief already lists it as expected.

## 한 것 (커밋 `refactor: 공통 모듈 열셋을 pub 으로 연다 — 가시성만 (moai-50p5.hdd)`)

- 바뀐 것은 `src/lib.rs` 의 모듈 선언 13줄뿐이다(`mod x;` → `pub mod x;`). `pub(crate)` → `pub` 은 0개
- **연 모듈 (후보 여섯)**: `model`·`fail`·`config`·`query`·`report`·`store`
- **따라 연 모듈 (일곱)**: 첫 바퀴 `held`·`i18n`·`nav`·`tz`·`user_config`, 둘째 바퀴 `read_marks`·`style`. 셋째 바퀴에 `cargo clippy --lib -- -W unnameable_types` 가 0

- **뺀 모듈**: 없다. `id`·`scratch`·`git_leaks` 에는 닿지 않았다
- **`pub(crate)` 로 남은 것**: 연 모듈 안의 `pub(crate)` 항목(store 33, report 28, held 14, user_config 10, query 8, model 7, read_marks 2, config 1, i18n 1)은 크레이트 밖에서 안 보인다. 기본 린트가 아무것도 안 가리켜 결정대로 안 건드렸다. 핵심 API(`Repo`·`Repo::open`·`Repo::at`·`Repo::find`·`Repo::with_write`·`parse_issues`·`Issue`·`Config`·`Lang`)는 이미 `pub` 이다 — `moai-50p5.gol` 이 실제로 부르며 확인한다

## 고른 방법이 본문과 다른 곳

- 본문 걸음 3 은 `private_interfaces`·`private_bounds` 를 따라 열라 했다. 그 린트는 이 크레이트에서 하나도 안 섰다 — 타입이 private 모듈 안에 `pub` 으로 선언돼 있어서다. 대신 그것을 잡는 `unnameable_types` 로 골랐다(앞 노트에 잰 것). 뜻(후보의 시그니처가 쓰는 타입의 모듈만 따라 연다)은 그대로다

## 밖에서 못 닿는 것 (일부러 우회하지 않았다)

- `query::Where::of` 와 `store::Repo::moved` 는 `#[cfg(test)]` 라 다른 크레이트가 못 부른다. `Where::from_soil(.., report::Soil::of(..))` 를 썼다 — 바이너리가 쓰는 길이다

## 결정

- 임시 디렉터리는 `std::env::temp_dir()` 밑(pid·나노초 이름)에 두고 `Drop` 에서 지운다 — `target/` 밑에 두면 워크트리의 일부로 읽혀 트래커가 루트로 옮겨 쓰일 수 있다

- 3·6·7·13: `CONTRIBUTING.md` 의 "The library" — 같은 커밋. 주장을 소스로 확인함(`PARTIAL` 은 `init` 의 `take_partial` 만 되돌림, `EXIT` 는 안 되돌림, `AFTER` 는 `cmd::run` 이 비움, edition 2024)
- 4·5·8·9·14 는 같은 절에 빈자리로 적었다(넘김과 함께)
- 15 의 일부와 5 의 gantt 근거: 주석 아홉 자리 — `fix(lib): 리뷰가 찾은 낡은 주석 아홉 자리 …`. +/- 줄이 다 주석, 파일마다 줄 수 같음

### 넘긴 것 (백로그)

- 4 → `moai-u5s2` 라이브러리 표면을 넓힐지(사람의 결정)
- 5 → `moai-vg09` 꺼진 dead_code·clippy 린트 되찾기
- 9 → `moai-hy35` 공개 쓰기 경로의 규율을 코드로 — 다음 에픽(전역 상태 → 호출마다의 맥락)과 함께
- 14, 상한 밖 `cargo doc` 241건 → `moai-islg`
- 15 의 나머지 약 30줄, 상한 밖 `skill.rs:613`·`git_leaks.rs:7` → `moai-prcq`
- 상한 밖 시험 바이너리 195MB → `moai-cqkn`

### 왜 이 에픽에서 다 안 고치나

- 에픽이 허용한 프로덕트 변경은 `mod`→`pub mod`, `pub(crate)`→`pub` 둘뿐이다(사람 결정: 동작 변경 0, 위험 안 받음). 넘긴 것은 표면을 넓히거나(4), 설정·설계를 바꾸거나(5), 로직을 바꾸거나(9), `cfg` 를 바꾼다(14)
- 15 의 나머지는 주석이라 위험은 없지만 범위를 넘겨 넓히지 않는다. 에픽이 낸 오해를 사는 자리(`main::fail` 등)는 고쳤다
